hooks.command: cd /home/user/claude-experiments && BRANCH=$(git branch --show-current) && UNPUSHED=$(git log @{u}.. --oneline 2>/dev/null | wc -l) && REMOTE=$(git config --get branch.$BRANCH.remote 2>/dev/null) && if [ -z "$REMOTE" ]; then echo "[hook]: Branch '$BRANCH' has no remote. Push with: git push -u origin $BRANCH"; elif [ "$UNPUSHED" -gt 0 ]; then echo "[hook]: Branch '$BRANCH' has $UNPUSHED unpushed commit(s). Run: git push"; fi
